---
title: "Analysis"
output: html_notebook
---

`nix develop` then `renv::restore()` from the project root.

```{r setup}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(yaml)
library(jsonlite)
library(brms)
library(posterior)
library(bayesplot)

config <- read_yaml(here("analysis", "analysis_config.yaml"))
set.seed(config$seed)
pal <- config$palette$colors

fig_dir <- here(config$paths$figures)
tab_dir <- here(config$paths$tables)
dir.create(fig_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(tab_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

save_results <- function(name, x) {
  path <- here(config$paths$results)
  out <- if (file.exists(path)) fromJSON(path, simplifyVector = FALSE) else list()
  out[[name]] <- x
  write_json(out, path, pretty = TRUE, auto_unbox = TRUE)
}

df <- read_csv(here(config$paths$dataset_one), show_col_types = FALSE)
df
```

## t-test

```{r ttest}
tt <- t.test(outcome ~ treatment, data = df, var.equal = TRUE)
tt

save_results("ttest_ind_r", list(
  statistic = unname(tt$statistic),
  pvalue = tt$p.value,
  df = unname(tt$parameter)
))
```

## brms

```{r fit}
df <- df |> mutate(treatment = factor(treatment, levels = c(0, 1)))

fit <- brm(
  outcome ~ 0 + treatment,
  data = df,
  family = gaussian(),
  prior = c(
    prior(normal(0, 10), class = b),
    prior(normal(0, 10), class = sigma)
  ),
  chains = config$r$chains,
  iter = config$r$iter,
  seed = config$seed,
  backend = "cmdstanr",
  silent = 2,
  refresh = 0
)
fit
```

```{r effect}
draws <- as_draws_df(fit)
beta <- draws$b_treatment1 - draws$b_treatment0

summ <- tibble(
  term = c("b_treatment0", "b_treatment1", "sigma"),
  mean = c(mean(draws$b_treatment0), mean(draws$b_treatment1), mean(draws$sigma)),
  sd = c(sd(draws$b_treatment0), sd(draws$b_treatment1), sd(draws$sigma)),
  q03 = c(
    quantile(draws$b_treatment0, 0.03),
    quantile(draws$b_treatment1, 0.03),
    quantile(draws$sigma, 0.03)
  ),
  q97 = c(
    quantile(draws$b_treatment0, 0.97),
    quantile(draws$b_treatment1, 0.97),
    quantile(draws$sigma, 0.97)
  )
)
summ
write_csv(summ, file.path(tab_dir, "brms_alpha_sigma.csv"))

save_results("treatment_effect_r", list(
  beta = mean(beta),
  ci_low = unname(quantile(beta, 0.03)),
  ci_high = unname(quantile(beta, 0.97))
))

color_scheme_set(c(
  pal$mist_sky, pal$moss_light, pal$cedar_needle,
  pal$forest_shade, pal$deep_grove, pal$ember_clay
))
mcmc_intervals(cbind(beta = beta), prob = 0.89, prob_outer = 0.94) +
  theme(plot.background = element_rect(fill = pal$mist_sky, color = NA))
ggsave(
  file.path(fig_dir, "trace_treatment_effect_r.png"),
  width = 6,
  height = 3,
  dpi = 150,
  device = grDevices::png
)
```
